''See also: [[Storm Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Storm [[Sage]] is a powerful figure associated with the [[Stormcaller]] sect. This individual has been known to use [[spatial transfer]] and possesses a manic, unpredictable personality, often exhibiting intense emotions such as blind fury or laughter. In combat, the Storm [[Sage]] has demonstrated the ability to catch heavy weapons with bare hands and ride a [[Forged lightning dragon]]. This entity is also linked to the [[destruction]] of a people and the torture of an individual named [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]. A related or potentially synonymous entity is the [[Sage of Calling Storms]], a manic-looking man with pale hair and blue lightning serpents circling his arms. This [[Sage]] utilizes [[Storm madra|storm madra]], which is derived from the [[Weeping Dragon]], and can manifest lightning from his fingertips to sear a person's [[spirit]]. The [[Sage of Calling Storms]] has also been known to use a floating metal shield from his [[soulspace]] for defense and can command gold-and-blue serpentine [[dragons]] made of [[madra]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Storm [[Sage]] destroyed the people of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] and subjected him to torture. Additionally, [[Yerin]] devoured power from the Storm [[Sage]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During a fierce battle, the Storm [[Sage]] fought while riding upon a [[Forged lightning dragon]]. Although he possessed great skill in [[spatial transfer]] during his lifetime, his ability to regenerate was slow during the conflict. While engaging in combat, he used hands crackling with lightning to catch [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s hammer. Ultimately, [[Yerin]] managed to devour power from the Storm [[Sage]].}}
